request.subject: PORTRAIT:MARTIAN:GUARD

layers.text: Change only his gear: add big rounded silver shoulder plates, and replace the small pistol with the top half of one big round silver dish emitter with a glowing hot magenta centre held in front of his chest, with one thin curved hot magenta arc of energy above the dish. Keep his head, big black eyes, glass bubble helmet, antenna, silver suit, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
